''Mammillaria albidula'' [[Curt Backeberg|Backeb.]] }} '''''Mammillaria haageana''''' is a species of cacti in the tribe [[Cacteae]].{{cite web |url= http://www.catalogueoflife.org/annual-checklist/2014/details/species/id/13439363|title= Species 2000 & ITIS Catalogue of Life: 2014 Annual Checklist.|author= Roskov Y.|author2= Kunze T.|author3= Orrell T.|author4= Abucay L.|author5= Paglinawan L.|author6= Culham A.|author7= Bailly N.|author8= Kirk P.|author9= Bourgoin T.|author10= Baillargeon G.|author11= Decock W.|author12= De Wever A.|editor= Didžiulis V.|year= 2014|publisher= Species 2000: Reading, UK.|accessdate= 26 May 2014}} It is native to [[Mexico]], where it is found commonly, and is widespread throughout much of the country. ==Gallery== Mammillaria haageana pm 2.JPG Mammillaria haageana ssp acultzingensis pm 1.JPG Mammillaria haageana elegans T139.jpg Guatiza - Jardín de Cactus - Lanzarote - J41.jpg ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.tropicos.org/Name/5106225 ''Mammillaria haageana''] at [[Tropicos]] {{Taxonbar|from=Q1661943}} [[Category:Plants described in 1836]] [[Category:Mammillaria|haageana]] {{cactus-stub}}
